elements.tagline: Software Engineering Student @ PUCPR • iOS Automation QA Intern @ Mitel
elements.title: André Gustavo Reitz Fleischfresser
elements.manifesto: I like building things, experimenting, and learning by doing. My engineering path spans robotics, embedded systems, full-stack backends, automated iOS QA, and native app products.

gap_centerpiece.title: Gap — Native iOS Product Case Study
gap_centerpiece.tagline: Designed, prototyped, and built around real user friction points

screenshot_placeholders.design_spec: Elegant CSS-rendered iPhone device frame container with clean replacement toggle state, interactive zoom preview, and explicit 'Replaceable Screenshot Placeholder' callout badge.

case_study_content.problem_statement: Addressing fragmentation and cognitive friction in mobile workflows through tight native Swift execution.
key_features: Native iOS UI built with modern architectural patterns
Automated UI and Integration test suite coverage
Performance-optimized local persistence & reactive state stream
case_study_content.architecture_details: MVVM-C with reactive bindings, local caching engine, and modular domain logic.

featured_projects.title: HelpDesk System
featured_projects.description: Enterprise ticket management and incident routing platform featuring automated SLA tracking, role-based access control, and asynchronous queue workers.
featured_projects.case_study: Built to solve operational bottleneck in support workflows with real-time websocket updates and clean REST API contracts.

featured_projects.title: Elder-Watch
featured_projects.description: IoT hardware-software ecosystem combining low-power microcontroller sensors with emergency detection algorithms and immediate caregiver notification relays.
featured_projects.case_study: Prototyped hardware sensors with C/C++, created telemetry pipelines, and designed resilient fall-detection alert dispatchers.

featured_projects.title: PromoSearch
featured_projects.description: Automated e-commerce deal aggregator and real-time price tracker utilizing asynchronous scrapers, data normalization pipelines, and instant alert webhooks.
featured_projects.case_study: Handles multi-source product catalog ingestion, deduplication logic, and low-latency full-text indexing for fast query responses.

smaller_projects.title: Robotics Navigation Controller
smaller_projects.description: Autonomous obstacle avoidance and motor feedback loop control using sensor telemetry.

smaller_projects.title: Native iOS Component Lab
smaller_projects.description: Experimental collection of custom UIKit / SwiftUI gestures and fluid layout transitions.

smaller_projects.title: QA Automation Test Runner CLI
smaller_projects.description: Utility script for executing XCTest and Appium test suits with structured HTML report generation.

smaller_projects.title: API Rate Limiter Middleware
smaller_projects.description: Token-bucket sliding window rate limiting module for high-concurrency microservices.

highlights: Developing and maintaining automated test scripts for native iOS enterprise communication applications.
Collaborating with cross-functional iOS development teams to identify edge cases, regression risks, and UI bugs early in CI/CD cycles.
Building robust XCTest and XCUITest automation frameworks to increase release confidence and reduce manual validation cycles.

stages.insight: Understanding how software interacts with physical constraints, memory limits, and real-time signals.
Architecting scalable data models, RESTful contracts, and reliable service infrastructure.
Developing an engineer's mindset for reliability, edge case detection, and automated CI test suites at Mitel.
Crafting fluid, high-performance mobile user experiences with Swift, SwiftUI, and thoughtful product iteration.

currently_exploring: XCUITest Parallel Execution & CI Pipeline Integration
System Architecture & Performance Profiling with Instruments
Human Interface Design Principles & Accessibility Standards

interactive_enhancements.framer_motion: Subtle, understated entrance animations with low duration (0.2s - 0.4s) and natural easing

interactive_enhancements.copy_email_toast: Sonner toast notification on clicking copy email button

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user criteria: Keep the site clean, restrained, editorial, and product-focused.
Do NOT use Apple logos or implies affiliation with Apple or Apple Developer Academy.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-link-gap', data-testid='github-hero-button', data-testid='copy-email-button').
The Gap project MUST be the largest visual centerpiece on the page, featuring 3 customizable/replaceable iPhone screenshot placeholders.
Placeholders for Gap and other projects should look premium, deliberate, and explicitly marked as replacement-ready prototypes.
Ensure complete responsive optimization for both mobile (iPhone screen sizes) and desktop viewports.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when user clicks copy email or interactive buttons.
